runs.question: Which four functions make up the NIST AI RMF Core, and which one is described as cross-cutting?

answer.text:
The AI RMF Core has four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE. The Core is composed of four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE.

GOVERN is the cross-cutting one. The framework describes it as a cross-cutting function to inform and be infused throughout the other three functions. Its scope also differs from the other three: GOVERN applies to all stages of organizations' AI risk management processes and procedures, while the MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE functions can be applied in AI system-specific contexts and at specific stages of the AI lifecycle.

All of this comes from NIST AI 100-1 (AI RMF 1.0), the only document in the collection.
